title: metadata: a bare action read picks between a package-less action and a package holder (and misses with a disabled package registered first)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi1tLRTEYwYGtbNCyk

Carrier filed from contract review 6781770671 on PR #32361 (card #32244, ③ out-of-scope finding 1, confirmed). It is pre-existing on main and outside #32244's wording, which covers two or more package holders. Child of the ADR-0150 epic #31527.

**Governing text:** ADR-0150 D3: for a caller with no package, the environment item answers first, then the unique package holder, else a refusal naming the candidates. D5: a bare address is never a silent pick.

Three cases, all with no package named (`GET /meta/action/NAME`, `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME)`):
1. **A package-less (environment or platform) action on one object, beside one package's action on another object.** The store's `refuseAcrossOwners` skips package-less keys (package-slotted-store.ts:353 at PR head `ddcaeda0`), so the read answers written-last between the two. By D3 the environment item answers first.
2. **Two packages hold the name, plus an environment row.** The environment row binds to no one (`overlaySlotBinding` in packages/objectql/src/registry.ts), so the new 409 names neither it nor any address for it. #31697 behaves the same for the object-less key.
3. **A disabled package registered before one enabled holder.** The judge drops the disabled holder, but step 3 is still `getItem`, which serves the first composite (registry.ts:8531-8536), and the face then withholds the disabled package's item (protocol-meta-item-face.ts:69). The bare read answers no item although one enabled package holds the name. #32361's CONTROL pins only the enabled-first order.

**Re-check:** after #32361 merges, `git grep -n "refuseAcrossOwners" packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`. The package-less skip still being there means case 1 holds.

**Serial:** after #32361 (#32244) merges.
